guides.title: 2027학년도 3월 입학 순수외국인전형 모집요강
guides.submission_channel: online application via the OIA site (https://oias.cau.ac.kr/cauoie/index.do) + original documents by post (postmark by deadline) or in person to Office of International Affairs, Room 210, Bldg 310

language_rules.note: Required for final admission, not to apply: applicants below the standard may apply and be selected as 예비합격자, then must meet it within 2 years and re-apply to the same unit (p.13, p.32). 디자인학부 and 글로벌예술학부(실용음악, 게임콘텐츠·애니메이션) need TOPIK 3.
Chung-Ang University Language Education Institute only.
IEQAS-certified Korean universities' Korean course level 5 (2025 list, p.37); '입학 시에만 적용'.
language_rules.evidence: 국내 교육국제화역량 인증대학 한국어교육과정 5급 이상 수료
국내 소재 고등학교 1~3학년 전 과정 이수 후 졸업(예정)한 자로 TOPIK 소지자에 준하는 한국어능력이 있다고 판단되는 자(국내 소재 외국인학교 제외)

language_rules.note: School of Convergence Engineering (융합공학부): required to apply.
School of Medicine (의학부): required to apply.

게임융합학과 (English track) only; 3.5 on the new scale for tests from 2026-01-21. Exempt: graduates of a regular high school in an English native/official-language country who completed the whole programme in English.
language_rules.evidence: TOEFL IBT 60(환산점수 3.5)1) 이상 혹은 IELTS 5.5 이상

language_rules.note: 게임융합학과 only. Guide says 'IELTS' without specifying Academic.
language_rules.evidence: TOEFL IBT 60(환산점수 3.5)1) 이상 혹은 IELTS 5.5 이상

requirements.name_en: Application form (printed after online application)
requirements.note: Applicants to two choices print both the 1st- and 2nd-choice application forms (p.31).

requirements.name: 정부기관에서 발행하는 학생과 부모의 관계증명서

notes: Page references are printed page numbers (the PDF is laid out as two-page spreads).

The OIA page labels this file '(KOR) 2027학년도 전반기(3월입학) 1차 순수외국인전형 모집요강'; the overview table on p.13 lists both 1차 and 2차 rounds, but the detailed sections (p.19, p.29, p.31) print only 1차 dates. Top-level dates are the upcoming 2차 round from p.13; 2차 times of day are not printed.
PDF server Last-Modified 2026-10-19; no publication date printed.

All documents are originals in principle; if only one original exists, a copy verified against the original by the OIA is accepted. Non-Korean/English documents need a Korean or English notarized translation (p.31).
Documents are accepted by post if postmarked by the deadline (p.30-31).
The guide has no separate English-track freshman programme except 게임융합학과 (English score required); track recorded as KOREAN.

Selection: most units document evaluation 100%; 의학부 documents 50% + interview 50%; arts/sports documents 50% + practical/portfolio 50% (p.18). Fee 150,000 KRW (2nd choice 60,000; arts/sports 200,000).
Preliminary admittees re-applying must resubmit family and language documents issued within 3 months of the submission date (p.31).

gaps: Graduate (MASTER/DOCTORATE) international guide not researched in this pass.
2차 round time-of-day and detailed document-submission dates are not printed separately; only the p.13 overview gives 2026.11.16 ~ 11.27.
Validity window '번역 공증일 3개월 이내' is stated in months; issuance_max_age_days left null to avoid converting months to days.
Detailed China vocational-school route on p.36 summarised in a note, not split into separate requirements.
